props.SQL select query:
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan 
SELECT
main.monthkey AS monthkey,
main.loaicapcha_dvgiao AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
main.loaicap_dvgiao AS loaicap_dvgiao,
main.iddv_dvgiao AS iddv_dvgiao,
main.donvi_dvgiao AS donvi_dvgiao,
main.tenviettat_dvgiao AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
main.loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
main.loaicap AS loaicap,
main.iddv AS iddv,
main.donvi AS donvi,
main.tenviettat AS tenviettat,
main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
main.LinhVuc AS LinhVuc,
main.Kieu AS Kieu,
main.tongso AS tongso,
main.daht AS daht,
main.daht_dh AS daht_dh,
main.daht_qh AS daht_qh,
main.daht_kh AS daht_kh,
main.dangth AS dangth,
main.dangth_th AS dangth_th,
main.dangth_qh AS dangth_qh,
main.dangth_sqh AS dangth_sqh,
main.dangth_kh AS dangth_kh,
main.nhomvb_ma AS nhomvb_ma,
main.nhomvb AS nhomvb,
main.syncdate AS syncdate

FROM (
SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m') + 0 AS monthkey,
		CASE
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		NULL AS loaicap_dvgiao,
    dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvgiao,
    IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvgiao,
    
		IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
		
		CASE
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha,
		NULL AS loaicap,
    d.DepartmentId AS iddv,
    IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
    
		IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
		CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode,"Số ","")
				WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
		CASE
        WHEN r.Type = 1 THEN 'Chỉ thị'
        WHEN r.Type = 2 THEN 'Nghị quyết'
				WHEN r.Type = 3 THEN 'Công văn'
				WHEN r.Type = 4 THEN 'Kết luận'
				WHEN r.Type = 5 THEN 'Thông báo'
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS Kieu,

    /* Tổng số */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* Nhóm đã hoàn thành (Status = 4) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  <= t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  > t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
		NULL as daht_kh,
    /* Nhóm đang thực hiện (Status in -1,0,1,2,3) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
		SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
		NULL AS dangth_kh,
		
		COALESCE(rg4.ResolutionGroupId,rg3.ResolutionGroupId,rg2.ResolutionGroupId,rg1.ResolutionGroupId,rg.ResolutionGroupId) AS nhomvb_ma,
		COALESCE(rg4.Name,rg3.Name,rg2.Name,rg1.Name,rg.Name)  AS nhomvb,
		NOW() AS syncdate

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d ON d.DepartmentIdExt = t.TargetDepartment
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao ON dv_giao.DepartmentIdExt = t.AssignDepartment
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg ON r.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ResolutionGroupId -- mức 1: cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg1 ON rg1.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg1.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 2: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg2 ON rg2.ResolutionGroupId = rg1.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg2.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 3: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg3 ON rg3.ResolutionGroupId = rg2.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg3.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 4: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg4 ON rg4.ResolutionGroupId = rg3.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg4.IsRoot = 0
WHERE
    t.Status <> 5
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m'),
		t.AssignDepartment,
    t.TargetDepartment,
		t.DocCode
		) main
ORDER BY 
    monthkey,
    iddv;

SELECT	
    main.monthkey AS monthkey,
    LEFT(CAST(main.monthkey AS CHAR),4) AS `year`,
    main.don_vi_khoi AS loaicapcha,
    main.don_vi_cap AS loaicap,
    main.don_vi_id AS iddv,
    main.don_vi AS donvi,
    main.don_vi AS tenviettat,

    main.can_bo_id AS canbo_id,
    main.can_bo_ho_ten AS canbo_hoten,
    main.can_bo_account AS account,
    main.can_bo_chuc_danh AS can_bo_chuc_danh,
    main.can_bo_chuc_vu AS can_bo_chuc_vu,

    ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) AS diem_danhgia,

    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_chinhtritutuong,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_nanglucvakynang,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_nhiemvu,

    main.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly AS tongso,
		main.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc AS ky_truoc_chuyen_sang,
		main.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang AS den_han_trong_thang,
    main.daht AS daht,
    main.daht_dung_han AS daht_dh,
    main.daht_qua_han AS daht_qh,
    0 AS daht_kh,

    main.dangth AS dangth,
    main.dangth_trong_han AS dangth_th,
    main.dangth_qua_han AS dangth_qh,
    0 AS dangth_sqh,
    0 AS dangth_kh,

    main.tyle_hoanthanh,

    -- tháng trước
    main.tongso_thangtruoc,
		main.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc_thangtruoc AS ky_truoc_chuyen_sang_thangtruoc,
		main.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thangtruoc AS den_han_trong_thang_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_thangtruoc AS daht_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_dh_thangtruoc AS daht_dh_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_qh_thangtruoc AS daht_qh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS daht_kh_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_thangtruoc AS dangth_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_th_thangtruoc AS dangth_th_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_qh_thangtruoc AS dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS dangth_kh_thangtruoc,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,

    main.diem_tc01 AS diem_tc01,
    main.diem_tc02 AS diem_tc02,
    main.diem_tc03 AS diem_tc03,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc04,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc05,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc06,

    CASE
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 90
            THEN 'Hoàn thành xuất sắc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 70
            THEN 'Hoàn thành tốt nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 50
            THEN 'Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Không hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
    END AS xeploai,

    CASE
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa đánh giá'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 90
            THEN 'Loại A'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 70
            THEN 'Loại B'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 50
            THEN 'Loại C'
        ELSE 'Loại D'
    END AS xeploai_loaidanhgia,

    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM (
    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.don_vi_khoi,
        t.don_vi_cap,
        t.don_vi_id,
        t.don_vi,
        t.can_bo_id,
        t.can_bo_ho_ten,
        t.can_bo_account,
        t.can_bo_chuc_danh,
        t.can_bo_chuc_vu,

        t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,
        t.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc,
        t.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang,
        t.daht,
        t.daht_dung_han,
        t.daht_qua_han,
        t.dangth,
        t.dangth_trong_han,
        t.dangth_qua_han,

        ROUND(
            (
                IFNULL(t.daht_dung_han,0)
                + IFNULL(t.daht_qua_han,0)*0.75
            ) / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) * 100
        ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh,

        IFNULL(t_prev.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) AS tongso_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc,0) AS nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang,0) AS nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht,0) AS daht_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht_dung_han,0) AS daht_dh_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht_qua_han,0) AS daht_qh_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth,0) AS dangth_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_trong_han,0) AS dangth_th_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qua_han,0) AS dangth_qh_thangtruoc,

				100 * IFNULL(t.daht / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly, 0), 0) AS diem_tc01,
				100 * IFNULL(t.daht / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly, 0), 0) AS diem_tc02,

        ROUND(
            (
                IFNULL(t.daht_dung_han,0)
                + IFNULL(t.daht_qua_han,0)*0.75
            ) / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) * 100
        ,2) AS diem_tc03

FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly a
    WHERE a.monthkey IN (
        DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') + 0,
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y%m') + 0
    )
) t

    LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly t_prev
        ON t_prev.can_bo_id = t.can_bo_id
        AND t_prev.monthkey = DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(
                STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(t.monthkey,'01'),'%Y%m%d'),
                INTERVAL 1 MONTH
            ),
            '%Y%m'
        ) + 0
) main;

/* ===== THIẾT LẬP THÁNG ===== */
SET @monthkey = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') AS UNSIGNED);
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly;

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly
SELECT
    m.monthkey,
    u.loaicapcha,
    u.loaicap,
    u.iddv,
    u.donvi,

    u.canbo_id,
    u.canbo_hoten,
    u.account,
		u.canbo_chuc_danh,
		u.canbo_chuc_vu,
    /* ===== tổng hợp ===== */
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qh,0))
      + IFNULL(t_now.tongso,0)
      AS tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,

    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qh,0))
      AS nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc,

    IFNULL(t_now.tongso,0)
      AS nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang,

    /* ===== đã hoàn thành ===== */
    IFNULL(t_now.daht,0)     AS da_hoan_thanh,
    IFNULL(t_now.daht_dh,0)  AS da_hoan_thanh_dung_han,
    IFNULL(t_now.daht_qh,0)  AS da_hoan_thanh_qua_han,

    /* ===== đang thực hiện ===== */
    IFNULL(t_now.dangth,0)      AS dang_thuc_hien,
    IFNULL(t_now.dangth_th,0)   AS dang_thuc_hien_trong_han,
    IFNULL(t_now.dangth_qh,0)   AS dang_thuc_hien_qua_han,
		NOW()

FROM
(
    /* ===== danh sách tháng ===== */
    SELECT DISTINCT monthkey
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan
    WHERE monthkey <= @monthkey
) m

CROSS JOIN
(
    /* ===== danh sách cán bộ từ dm_user ===== */
    SELECT
        canbo_id,
        canbo_hoten,
        account,
        loaicapcha,
        loaicap,
        iddv,
        donvi,
        tenviettat,
				canbo_chuc_danh,
				canbo_chuc_vu
    FROM datamart_hanoi.dm_user
    WHERE loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
) u

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ tháng này (không lũy kế) ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh


    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t_now
ON t_now.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND t_now.monthkey = m.monthkey

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh


    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t_prev

ON t_prev.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND t_prev.monthkey < m.monthkey

WHERE m.monthkey <= @monthkey

GROUP BY
    m.monthkey,
    u.canbo_id

/* ===== THIẾT LẬP THÁNG ===== */
SET @monthkey = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') AS UNSIGNED);

SELECT

    main.canbo_hoten,

		main.canbo_chuc_danh,
		main.canbo_chuc_vu,
		

    main.diem_danhgia,
    main.diem_chinhtritutuong,
    main.diem_nanglucvakynang,
    main.diem_nhiemvu,

    main.tongso,
    main.daht,
    main.daht_dh,
    main.daht_qh,
    main.daht_kh,

    main.dangth,
    main.dangth_th,
    main.dangth_qh,
    main.dangth_sqh,
    main.dangth_kh,

    main.tyle_hoanthanh,
		
		main.tongso_thangtruoc,
		main.daht_thangtruoc,
		main.daht_dh_thangtruoc,
		main.daht_qh_thangtruoc,
		main.daht_kh_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_th_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_kh_thangtruoc,
		main.tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,


    main.diem_tc01,
    main.diem_tc02,
    main.diem_tc03,
    main.diem_tc04,
    main.diem_tc05,
    main.diem_tc06,

    CASE
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia IS NULL THEN 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 90 THEN 'Hoàn thành xuất sắc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 70 THEN 'Hoàn thành tốt nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 50 THEN 'Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia <  50 THEN 'Không hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
				ELSE 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
    END AS xeploai,

    CASE
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia IS NULL THEN 'Chưa đánh giá'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 90 THEN 'Loại A'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 70 THEN 'Loại B'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 50 THEN 'Loại C'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia <  50 THEN 'Loại D'
				ELSE 'Chưa đánh giá'
    END AS xeploai_loaidanhgia

FROM
(
SELECT
    base.monthkey,
    base.`year`,
    base.loaicapcha,
    base.loaicap,
    base.iddv,
    base.donvi,
    base.tenviettat,
    base.canbo_id,
    base.canbo_hoten,
    base.account,
		base.canbo_chuc_danh,
		base.canbo_chuc_vu,
		

    ( ( base.diem_tc01 + base.diem_tc02 + base.diem_tc03 ) / 3 ) AS diem_danhgia,
    base.diem_chinhtritutuong,
    base.diem_nanglucvakynang,
    base.diem_nhiemvu,

    base.tongso,
    base.daht,
    base.daht_dh,
    base.daht_qh,
    base.daht_kh,

    base.dangth,
    base.dangth_th,
    base.dangth_qh,
    base.dangth_sqh,
    base.dangth_kh,

    base.tyle_hoanthanh,
		
		base.tongso_thangtruoc,
		base.daht_thangtruoc,
		base.daht_dh_thangtruoc,
		base.daht_qh_thangtruoc,
		base.daht_kh_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_th_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_kh_thangtruoc,
		base.tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,


    base.diem_tc01,
    base.diem_tc02,
    base.diem_tc03,
    base.diem_tc04,
    base.diem_tc05,
    base.diem_tc06,

    NULL AS xeploai,
		NULL AS xeploai_loaidanhgia

FROM
(

SELECT
    m.monthkey,
    LEFT(m.monthkey,4) AS `year`,

    u.loaicapcha,
    u.loaicap,
    u.iddv,
    u.donvi,
    u.tenviettat,

    u.canbo_id,
    u.canbo_hoten,
    u.account,
		u.canbo_chuc_danh,
		u.canbo_chuc_vu,

    /* ===== điểm ===== */

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) +
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0))*0.75
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS diem_danhgia,

    20 AS diem_chinhtritutuong,
    20 AS diem_nanglucvakynang,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)) = 0 THEN 60
        ELSE ROUND(
            (SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) /
            NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100) * 0.6
        ,2)
    END AS diem_nhiemvu,

    /* ===== thống kê tháng này ===== */

    SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)) AS tongso,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) AS daht,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0)) AS daht_qh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_kh,0)) AS daht_kh,

    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth,0)) AS dangth,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_th,0)) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_qh,0)) AS dangth_qh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_sqh,0)) AS dangth_sqh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_kh,0)) AS dangth_kh,

    ROUND(
        SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) /
        NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh,

    /* ===== thống kê tháng trước ===== */

    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.tongso,0)) AS tongso_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht,0)) AS daht_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht_dh,0)) AS daht_dh_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht_qh,0)) AS daht_qh_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht_kh,0)) AS daht_kh_thangtruoc,

    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth,0)) AS dangth_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_th,0)) AS dangth_th_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qh,0)) AS dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_sqh,0)) AS dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_kh,0)) AS dangth_kh_thangtruoc,

    ROUND(
        SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht,0)) /
        NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0))
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS diem_tc01,
    100 AS diem_tc02,
    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) +
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0))*0.75
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS diem_tc03,
    NULL AS diem_tc04,
    NULL AS diem_tc05,
    NULL AS diem_tc06

FROM
(
    /* ===== danh sách tháng ===== */
    SELECT DISTINCT monthkey
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan
    WHERE monthkey <= @monthkey
) m

CROSS JOIN
(
    /* ===== danh sách cán bộ từ dm_user ===== */
    SELECT
        canbo_id,
        canbo_hoten,
        account,
        loaicapcha,
        loaicap,
        iddv,
        donvi,
        tenviettat,
				canbo_chuc_danh,
				canbo_chuc_vu
    FROM datamart_hanoi.dm_user
    WHERE loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'
) u

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh


    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND t.loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t

ON t.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND t.monthkey <= m.monthkey

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh


    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND t.loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t_prev
ON t_prev.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(t_prev.monthkey, '01'), '%Y%m%d')
    = DATE_SUB(
        STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(t.monthkey, '01'), '%Y%m%d'),
        INTERVAL 1 MONTH
      )

WHERE m.monthkey <= @monthkey

GROUP BY
    m.monthkey,
    u.canbo_id
) base
) main

ORDER BY
    main.monthkey,
    main.canbo_id

TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi
SELECT
    main.monthkey,
    main.donvi,
    main.tong_nhan_su,
		main.tong_nhiem_vu AS tong_nhiem_vu,
    main.kpi_current,
    main.kpi_prev,
    main.kpi_current - main.kpi_prev AS kpi_trend
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.donvi,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.canbo_id) AS tong_nhan_su,
				SUM(tongso) AS tong_nhiem_vu,

        ROUND(
            (
                (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0))
                + (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0))
                + IFNULL(
                    100 * (IFNULL(SUM(daht_dh), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(daht_qh), 0) * 0.75)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0
                )
            ) / 3, 1
        ) AS kpi_current,

        ROUND(
            (
                (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht_thangtruoc) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0))
                + (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht_thangtruoc) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0))
                + IFNULL(
                    100 * (IFNULL(SUM(daht_dh_thangtruoc), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(daht_qh_thangtruoc), 0) * 0.75)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0
                )
            ) / 3, 1
        ) AS kpi_prev

    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_cbcc_danhgia t
    GROUP BY t.monthkey, t.donvi

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        'Tất cả đơn vị' AS donvi,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.canbo_id) AS tong_nhan_su,
				SUM(tongso) AS tongso,

        ROUND(
            (
                (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0))
                + (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0))
                + IFNULL(
                    100 * (IFNULL(SUM(daht_dh), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(daht_qh), 0) * 0.75)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0
                )
            ) / 3, 1
        ) AS kpi_current,

        ROUND(
            (
                (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht_thangtruoc) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0))
                + (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht_thangtruoc) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0))
                + IFNULL(
                    100 * (IFNULL(SUM(daht_dh_thangtruoc), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(daht_qh_thangtruoc), 0) * 0.75)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0
                )
            ) / 3, 1
        ) AS kpi_prev

    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_cbcc_danhgia t
    GROUP BY t.monthkey
) main;

TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_quahan;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_quahan
SELECT
    LEFT(g.monthkey,4) AS yearkey,
    g.loaicapcha,
    g.loaicap,
    g.iddv,
    g.donvi,
    g.tenviettat,
		g.iddv_captren,

    g.loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
    g.loaicap_dvthuchien,
    g.iddv_dvthuchien,
    g.donvi_dvthuchien,
    g.tenviettat_dvthuchien,
		g.iddv_captren_dvthuchien,

    g.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    g.LinhVuc,
    g.Kieu,
    g.UuTien,

    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_dh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_kh,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_th,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_sqh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN g.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành không hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_kh,

    SUM(g.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
    SUM(g.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    /* số ngày quá hạn lớn nhất */
    qh.songayquahan_max AS songayquahan,

    /* thông tin nhiệm vụ có quá hạn lớn nhất */
    qh.Ma,
    qh.TenNhiemVu,
    qh.SanPhamChuYeu,
    qh.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
    qh.NgayHoanThanh,
    qh.TrangThai,
    qh.TienDoHoanThanh,
    qh.nhomvb_ma,
    qh.nhomvb,

    COALESCE(rpt.SoLanYeuCauBCTD, 0) AS SoLanYeuCauBCTD,
    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_giaonv g

/* ===== lấy nhiệm vụ quá hạn lớn nhất ===== */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        LEFT(g1.monthkey,4) AS yearkey,
        g1.iddv,
        g1.iddv_dvthuchien,

        mx.songayquahan_max,

        g1.songayquahan,
        g1.Ma,
        g1.TenNhiemVu,
        g1.SanPhamChuYeu,
        g1.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
        g1.NgayHoanThanh,
        g1.TrangThai,
        g1.TienDoHoanThanh,
        g1.nhomvb_ma,
        g1.nhomvb
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_giaonv g1
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            LEFT(monthkey,4) AS yearkey,
            iddv,
            iddv_dvthuchien,
            MAX(songayquahan) AS songayquahan_max
        FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_giaonv
        WHERE TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
        GROUP BY
            LEFT(monthkey,4),
            iddv,
            iddv_dvthuchien
    ) mx
        ON  LEFT(g1.monthkey,4) = mx.yearkey
        AND g1.iddv = mx.iddv
        AND g1.iddv_dvthuchien = mx.iddv_dvthuchien
        AND g1.songayquahan = mx.songayquahan_max
    WHERE g1.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
) qh
    ON  LEFT(g.monthkey,4) = qh.yearkey
    AND g.iddv = qh.iddv
    AND g.iddv_dvthuchien = qh.iddv_dvthuchien

/* ===== JOIN báo cáo ===== */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        TaskId,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Type = 0 THEN 1 END) AS SoLanYeuCauBCTD
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report
    GROUP BY TaskId
) rpt
    ON rpt.TaskId = qh.Ma

GROUP BY
    LEFT(g.monthkey,4),
    g.loaicapcha,
    g.loaicap,
    g.iddv,
    g.donvi,
    g.tenviettat,
		g.iddv_captren,
    g.loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
    g.loaicap_dvthuchien,
    g.iddv_dvthuchien,
    g.donvi_dvthuchien,
    g.tenviettat_dvthuchien,
		g.iddv_captren_dvthuchien,
    g.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    g.LinhVuc,

TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_chitiet;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_chitiet
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate,'%Y') AS yearkey,
        r.ResolutionId,
        r.ResolutionGroupId,
        r.Compendium,
        r.DocCode,
        CASE
            WHEN r.Type = 1  THEN 'Chỉ thị'
            WHEN r.Type = 2  THEN 'Nghị quyết'
            WHEN r.Type = 3  THEN 'Công văn'
            WHEN r.Type = 4  THEN 'Kết luận'
            WHEN r.Type = 5  THEN 'Thông báo'
            WHEN r.Type = 6  THEN 'Đề nghị'
            WHEN r.Type = 7  THEN 'Quyết định'
            WHEN r.Type = 8  THEN 'Báo cáo'
            WHEN r.Type = 9  THEN 'Quy định'
            WHEN r.Type = 10 THEN 'Hợp đồng'
            WHEN r.Type = 11 THEN 'Đăng ký'
            WHEN r.Type = 12 THEN 'Biên bản'
            WHEN r.Type = 13 THEN 'Quy trình'
            WHEN r.Type = 14 THEN 'Hướng dẫn'
            WHEN r.Type = 15 THEN 'Kiến nghị'
            WHEN r.Type = 16 THEN 'Thanh tra'
            WHEN r.Type = 17 THEN 'Tờ trình'
            WHEN r.Type = 18 THEN 'Giấy phép'
            WHEN r.Type = 19 THEN 'Giấy mời'
            WHEN r.Type = 20 THEN 'Danh sách'
            WHEN r.Type = 21 THEN 'Kế hoạch'
            WHEN r.Type = 22 THEN 'Chương trình'
            WHEN r.Type = 23 THEN 'Giấy uỷ quyền'
            WHEN r.Type = 24 THEN 'Đề án'
            WHEN r.Type = 25 THEN 'Thông tư'
            WHEN r.Type = 26 THEN 'Quy chế'
            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS Kieu,
        s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
        DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate,'%d/%m/%Y') AS NgayVanban,
        r.AssignOrganizationName AS CoQuanBanHanh,
        CASE
            WHEN d.Level  = 2 THEN d.DepartmentName
            WHEN d1.Level = 2 THEN d1.DepartmentName
            WHEN d2.Level = 2 THEN d2.DepartmentName
            WHEN d3.Level = 2 THEN d3.DepartmentName
            WHEN d4.Level = 2 THEN d4.DepartmentName
            ELSE NULL
        END AS loaicapcha,
        CASE
            WHEN d.Level  = 3 THEN d.DepartmentName
            WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
            WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
            WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
            WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
            ELSE NULL
        END AS loaicap,
        d.ParentId        AS iddv_captren,
        d.DepartmentId    AS iddv,
        d.DepartmentName  AS donvi,
        IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName, 'Chưa xác định') AS tenviettat,
        r.CreateUser          AS nguoitao_id,
        u.eGovUserLabel       AS nguoitao_taikhoan,
        u.eGovUserFullname    AS nguoitao_ten,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.TaskId) AS so_nhiem_vu
    FROM
        (SELECT * FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL) r
        LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u ON r.CreateUser = u.eGovUserId
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d ON d.DepartmentIdExt = u.DepartmentPath
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1 ON d1.DepartmentId = d.ParentId
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2 ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3 ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId
        LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4 ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task WHERE Status <> 5 AND DeletedDate IS NULL) t ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
        LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
    WHERE d.DepartmentId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        r.ResolutionId,
        r.ResolutionGroupId,
        r.Compendium,
        r.DocCode,
        r.Type,
        s.SectorName,
        r.StartDate,
        r.CreateUser,
        u.eGovUserLabel,
        u.eGovUserFullname,
        d.DepartmentId,
        d.DepartmentName
) main
WHERE main.loaicap = 'Văn phòng UBND TP'
;

			WHEN r.Type = 3  THEN 'Công văn'
			WHEN r.Type = 4  THEN 'Kết luận'
			WHEN r.Type = 5  THEN 'Thông báo'
			WHEN r.Type = 6  THEN 'Đề nghị'
			WHEN r.Type = 7  THEN 'Quyết định'
			WHEN r.Type = 8  THEN 'Báo cáo'
			WHEN r.Type = 9  THEN 'Quy định'
			WHEN r.Type = 10 THEN 'Hợp đồng'
			WHEN r.Type = 11 THEN 'Đăng ký'
			WHEN r.Type = 12 THEN 'Biên bản'
			WHEN r.Type = 13 THEN 'Quy trình'
			WHEN r.Type = 14 THEN 'Hướng dẫn'
			WHEN r.Type = 15 THEN 'Kiến nghị'
			WHEN r.Type = 16 THEN 'Thanh tra'
			WHEN r.Type = 17 THEN 'Tờ trình'
			WHEN r.Type = 18 THEN 'Giấy phép'
			WHEN r.Type = 19 THEN 'Giấy mời'
			WHEN r.Type = 20 THEN 'Danh sách'
			WHEN r.Type = 21 THEN 'Kế hoạch'
			WHEN r.Type = 22 THEN 'Chương trình'
			WHEN r.Type = 23 THEN 'Giấy uỷ quyền'
			WHEN r.Type = 24 THEN 'Đề án'
			WHEN r.Type = 25 THEN 'Thông tư'
			WHEN r.Type = 26 THEN 'Quy chế'
			ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
	END AS Kieu,
	s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
	DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate,'%d/%m/%Y') AS NgayVanban,
	r.AssignOrganizationName AS CoQuanBanHanh,
	r.CreateUser AS nguoitao_id,
	CASE
			WHEN d.Level = 2 THEN d.DepartmentName
			WHEN d1.Level = 2 THEN d1.DepartmentName
			WHEN d2.Level = 2 THEN d2.DepartmentName
			WHEN d3.Level = 2 THEN d3.DepartmentName
			WHEN d4.Level = 2 THEN d4.DepartmentName
			ELSE NULL
	END AS loaicapcha,
	CASE
			WHEN d.Level = 3 THEN d.DepartmentName
			WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
			WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
			WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
			WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
			ELSE NULL
	END AS loaicap,
	u.Username AS nguoitao_taikhoan,
	u.FullName AS nguoitao_ten,
	d.DepartmentId AS iddv,
	d.DepartmentName AS donvi,
	IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
	COUNT(t.TaskId) AS so_nhiem_vu
FROM
	db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r
	LEFT JOIN egov_hanoi.`user` u ON r.CreateUser = u.UserId
	LEFT JOIN egov_hanoi.user_department_jobtitles_position udjp ON u.UserId = udjp.UserId
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d ON d.DepartmentId = udjp.DepartmentId
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
			ON d1.DepartmentId = d.ParentId
	/* Cha */
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
			ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId
	/* Ông */
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
			ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId
	/* Cụ */
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4
			ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s
         ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
  LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg
         ON r.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ResolutionGroupId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg1 ON rg1.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg1.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 2: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg2 ON rg2.ResolutionGroupId = rg1.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg2.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 3: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg3 ON rg3.ResolutionGroupId = rg2.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg3.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 4: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg4 ON rg4.ResolutionGroupId = rg3.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg4.IsRoot = 0
WHERE d.DepartmentId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
	r.ResolutionId,
	r.ResolutionGroupId,
	r.Compendium,
	r.DocCode,
	r.Type,
	s.SectorName,
	r.StartDate,
	r.CreateUser,
	u.Username,
	u.FullName,
	d.DepartmentId,
	d.DepartmentName
;

TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_btctw;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_btctw

SELECT
    t.monthkey,
		t.`year`,
		t.don_vi_cap_01,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		t.NgayVanBan,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,

    /* Tổng số nhiệm vụ */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* ===== ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_dh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_kh,

    /* ===== CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_th,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_sqh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(t.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(t.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_khoi_btctw t
GROUP BY
    t.monthkey,
		t.don_vi_cap_01,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,
    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.NhomGiaoNhan

        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName

TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi
SELECT
    c.monthkey,
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,

    /* ÉP loaicap = DepartmentName có Level = 3 */
    CASE
        WHEN c.iddv IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa xác định'
        WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
        WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
        WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
        ELSE NULL
    END AS loaicap,

    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
		d1.ParentId AS iddv_captren,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,

    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_dh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN 1 END) AS daht_kh,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_th,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_sqh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(c.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(c.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate
FROM ( SELECT * FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_donvi
			WHERE donvi_dvthuchien NOT IN ('Sở ngành', 'Xã, Phường') ) c

/* Level hiện tại */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
    ON c.iddv = d1.DepartmentId

/* Cha */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
    ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId

/* Ông */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
    ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId

/* Cụ */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4
    ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId

GROUP BY
    c.monthkey,
		c.Ma,
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,
    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
		d1.ParentId,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    loaicap

ORDER BY 
    c.monthkey,
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu
;

SET @monthkey = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') AS UNSIGNED);

INSERT INTO db_hdnd_qttt.qlnv_cbcc_danhgia_hdndtp
(
    monthkey,
    `year`,
    loaicapcha,
    loaicap,
    iddv,
    donvi,
    tenviettat,
    canbo_id,
    canbo_hoten,
    account,
		canbo_chuc_danh,
		canbo_chuc_vu,

    diem_danhgia,
    diem_chinhtritutuong,
    diem_nanglucvakynang,
    diem_nhiemvu,

    tongso,
    daht,
    daht_dh,
    daht_qh,
    daht_kh,

    dangth,
    dangth_th,
    dangth_qh,
    dangth_sqh,
    dangth_kh,

    tyle_hoanthanh,

    diem_tc01,
    diem_tc02,
    diem_tc03,
    diem_tc04,
    diem_tc05,
    diem_tc06,

    xeploai,
    xeploai_loaidanhgia
)

SELECT
    main.monthkey,
    main.`year`,
    main.loaicapcha,
    main.loaicap,
    main.iddv,
    main.donvi,
    main.tenviettat,
    main.canbo_id,
    main.canbo_hoten,
    main.account,
		main.canbo_chuc_danh,
		main.canbo_chuc_vu,
		

    main.diem_danhgia,
    main.diem_chinhtritutuong,
    main.diem_nanglucvakynang,
    main.diem_nhiemvu,

    main.tongso,
    main.daht,
    main.daht_dh,
    main.daht_qh,
    main.daht_kh,

    main.dangth,
    main.dangth_th,
    main.dangth_qh,
    main.dangth_sqh,
    main.dangth_kh,

    main.tyle_hoanthanh,

    main.diem_tc01,
    main.diem_tc02,
    main.diem_tc03,
    main.diem_tc04,
    main.diem_tc05,
    main.diem_tc06,

    CASE
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia IS NULL THEN 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 90 THEN 'Hoàn thành xuất sắc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 70 THEN 'Hoàn thành tốt nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 50 THEN 'Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Không hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
    END AS xeploai,

    CASE
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia IS NULL THEN 'Chưa đánh giá'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 90 THEN 'Loại A'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 70 THEN 'Loại B'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 50 THEN 'Loại C'
        ELSE 'Loại D'
    END AS xeploai_loaidanhgia

FROM
(

SELECT
    m.monthkey,
    LEFT(m.monthkey,4) AS `year`,

    u.loaicapcha,
    u.loaicap,
    u.iddv,
    u.donvi,
    u.tenviettat,

    u.canbo_id,
    u.canbo_hoten,
    u.account,
		u.canbo_chuc_danh,
		u.canbo_chuc_vu,

    /* ===== điểm ===== */

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) +
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0))*0.75
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS diem_danhgia,

    20 AS diem_chinhtritutuong,
    20 AS diem_nanglucvakynang,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)) = 0 THEN 60
        ELSE ROUND(
            (SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) /
            NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100) * 0.6
        ,2)
    END AS diem_nhiemvu,

    /* ===== thống kê ===== */

    SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)) AS tongso,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) AS daht,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0)) AS daht_qh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_kh,0)) AS daht_kh,

    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth,0)) AS dangth,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_th,0)) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_qh,0)) AS dangth_qh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_sqh,0)) AS dangth_sqh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_kh,0)) AS dangth_kh,

    ROUND(
        SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) /
        NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh,

    NULL AS diem_tc01,
    NULL AS diem_tc02,
    NULL AS diem_tc03,
    NULL AS diem_tc04,
    NULL AS diem_tc05,
    NULL AS diem_tc06

FROM
(
    /* ===== danh sách tháng ===== */
    SELECT DISTINCT monthkey
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan
    WHERE monthkey <= @monthkey
) m

CROSS JOIN
(
    /* ===== danh sách cán bộ từ dm_user ===== */
    SELECT
        canbo_id,
        canbo_hoten,
        account,
        loaicapcha,
        loaicap,
        iddv,
        donvi,
        tenviettat,
				canbo_chuc_danh,
				canbo_chuc_vu
    FROM datamart_hanoi.dm_user
    WHERE loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'
) u

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        COUNT(*) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành không hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh

    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND t.loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t

ON t.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND t.monthkey <= m.monthkey

WHERE m.monthkey <= @monthkey

GROUP BY
    m.monthkey,
    u.canbo_id

) main

ORDER BY
    main.monthkey,

TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_nq57;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_nq57
SELECT
    t.monthkey,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		t.NgayVanBan,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,

    /* Tổng số nhiệm vụ */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* ===== ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_dh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_kh,

    /* ===== CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_th,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_sqh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(t.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(t.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nq57 t
WHERE t.nhomvb = 'Văn bản chỉ đạo theo NQ 57' AND NOT ( t.NhomGiaoNhan = 'Được giao' AND t.loaicapcha = "Thành ủy Hà Nội")
GROUP BY
    t.monthkey,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,
    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,
		t.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    t.NhomGiaoNhan

		
UNION ALL

SELECT
		t.monthkey,

		"Thành ủy Hà Nội" AS loaicapcha,

		t.loai_nhiem_vu_viettat AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		NULL AS NgayVanBan,
		NULL AS LinhVuc,
		NULL AS Kieu,
		NULL AS UuTien,
		SUM( t.tong_so_nhiem_vu) AS tongso,
		SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh) AS daht,
		SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh_dung_han) AS daht_dh,
		SUM( t.da_hoan_thanh_qua_han) AS daht_qh,
		0 AS daht_kh,
		SUM( t.on_dinh_dung_han) + SUM( t.thuong_xuyen) + SUM( t.dang_tien_hanh_qua_han) AS dangth,
		SUM( t.on_dinh_dung_han) + SUM( t.thuong_xuyen) AS dangth_th,
		SUM( t.dang_tien_hanh_qua_han) AS dangth_qh,
		SUM( t.sap_den_han) AS dangth_sqh,
		0 AS dangth_kh,
		NULL AS tongtg_canxuly,
		NULL AS tongtg_daxuly,
		t.nhom_nhiem_vu AS nhomvb_ma,
		t.nhom_nhiem_vu AS nhomvb,
		'Nhiệm vụ ngoài khối' AS NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
		'Được giao' AS NhomGiaoNhan,
		MAX( t.syncdate)
FROM datamart_hanoi.tla_bao_cao_tong_quan t
GROUP BY 
 t.monthkey,
 t.loai_nhiem_vu_viettat,
 t.nhom_nhiem_vu
		
ORDER BY 
    monthkey,
    loaicapcha,
    VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    LinhVuc,
    Kieu,
		UuTien,
    nhomvb_ma,
    nhomvb,
		NhomGiaoNhan,
		NhomPhamViNhiemVu
;

TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_cham_muon_theo_don_vi;

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_cham_muon_theo_don_vi (
    yearkey,
    VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    NgayVanBan,
    loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
    loaicap_dvthuchien,
		iddv_dvthuchien,
    donvi_dvthuchien,
    so_nhiem_vu_cham_muon,
    sync_date
)
SELECT
    LEFT(g.`date`, 4) AS yearkey,
    g.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    g.NgayVanBan,
    g.loaicapcha_dvthuchien AS loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
    g.loaicap_dvthuchien AS loaicap_dvthuchien,
		g.iddv_dvthuchien AS iddv_dvthuchien,
    g.donvi_dvthuchien AS donvi_dvthuchien,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN g.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS so_nhiem_vu_cham_muon,
    NOW() AS sync_date
FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_giaonv g
-- WHERE loaicapcha ='Thành ủy Hà Nội'
GROUP BY
    LEFT(g.`date`, 4),
    g.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    g.NgayVanBan,
    g.loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
    g.loaicap_dvthuchien,
    g.iddv_dvthuchien,
    g.donvi_dvthuchien
;
